questions.q: What animal is drinking water with the lion?
questions.explain: The elephant is the only one explicitly mentioned as drinking water with the lion.

questions.q: How many animals are walking to the water?
questions.explain: There are 5 impalas and 6 warthogs walking to the water.

questions.q: Which animal is running to the water?
questions.explain: The zebras are running to the water.
